Hi Alexandra,

I'm [Your name] from Concentrix.

IKEA's 24 remote-sales centres grew 15-20% a year over three years, reaching EUR 1.25 billion in sales last fiscal year. In August, reports also said Billie now handles about 74% of the customers who use it, up from 47%.

How is cost per contact holding up as sales through the centres grow?

iX Hero, our agentic desktop for contact-center agents, gives them real-time answers and summaries with a human in the loop. I think it could be useful for agents in centres growing this fast.

Would 20 minutes next week work for a demo on one of your own scenarios?

Best,
